title: Launch consent evidence survives deleting its Launch or source

source.ref: Production catalog 2026-10-28: launch_list_attestations.launch_id NOT NULL ON DELETE CASCADE, so deleting a Launch erased the consent evidence for an imported list. Owner chose to keep minimal evidence (wording version, answer, time, pseudonymous original ids).

verify.note: Reads the forward migration for the detach-on-delete foreign keys, the kept launch_ref and source_ref, the source-belongs-to-launch check, the immutability trigger and the service_role revoke, and fails until lib/database.types.ts carries the new columns.

detail: Forward repair (20270346026000_vera_launch is applied and is never reapplied). launch_id becomes nullable with ON DELETE SET NULL; launch_ref and source_ref hold the original ids with no foreign key, stamped by a BEFORE INSERT trigger that also refuses a source from another Launch; a BEFORE UPDATE trigger allows only the foreign-key detach; a BEFORE DELETE trigger refuses deletes; service_role keeps SELECT and INSERT only. Owner reads stop once evidence detaches. Evidence deleted before the repair cannot be recovered (the production table held 0 rows on 2026-10-28). A privileged database owner can still bypass these controls. Not decided and not built: retention period, legal holds, subject requests, who may purge, audit of privileged access. pgTAP in supabase/tests/launch_consent_retention.test.sql (19 assertions); HTTP acceptance (owner, stranger, anonymous, service role, source and Launch deletion) in scripts/staging/launch-api.mjs.
